# Upstream indexed-history fixture

Generated by unmodified upstream
`123huangcan250/xiumi-ai-studio@550c0ef2e99e4d493bb0e9d017178aa7fbdc7fbe`
`server/dataTools.ts::writeBackup` from a disposable data directory. It contains
one current manuscript with an indexed red 16 × 12 PNG, one older snapshot
with an independent indexed blue 16 × 12 PNG, and one text-only snapshot of
that same manuscript. It also contains a separate text-only current manuscript
whose older version has its own indexed green 16 × 12 PNG. All images are
generated solid-colour transparent PNGs;
no external URLs, personal content, settings, or credentials are present.

To regenerate, seed those project, version, image, and index records in a
temporary directory and invoke the pinned writer with
`XIUMI_DATA_DIR=<temporary-directory> XIUMI_SKIP_ENV_FILES=1 node --import tsx`.
Call `writeBackup(output, '0.1.0')` and wait for the stream to finish. The
manifest timestamp varies between runs.
